digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified Gate CI voting workflow
propositions: The final Gerrit Verified vote cast fails red when gerrit review rejects the vote with 'fatal: change is closed' after the target change was abandoned or merged mid-run, even though CI work completed successfully.

The opaque gerrit-review-action invocation treats any nonzero gerrit review exit code as a hard GitHub Actions failure without distinguishing between terminal unvoteable states (closed change) and genuine vote failures on open changes.

A trusted default-branch helper script cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py must replace the final cast action to catch 'fatal: change is closed' in Gerrit output, emit an Actions notice, and exit 0 while preserving nonzero exit codes for real vote failures.

The helper must validate change/patchset IDs as positive decimals, manage SSH key and known_hosts files with chmod 600 and cleanup, and map vote types to the same Gerrit label tokens: success→Verified+1, failure→Verified-1, cancelled→Verified-1 Code-Review-1.
